name: poker-game
description: A terminal and web Texas Hold'em poker game: AI opponents, WebSocket or serverless P2P (WebRTC) online play with voice/text chat, and hex file save/export.

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/main.js local
scripts.start:server: npm run build && node dist/main.js host
scripts.start:client: npm run build && node dist/main.js join
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:web && npm run build:p2p
